Class C2paBuilder

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.jc2pa.C2paBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class C2paBuilder extends Object implements Closeable
High-level wrapper around the c2pa WASM builder functions.

Manages the lifetime of the underlying WASM builder handle.

Signing happens inside the WASM module. Two paths exist:

  1. signWithKeys(String, byte[], byte[], byte[], String, String) — the host supplies a PEM certificate chain and a PEM private key; the signature is computed by c2pa's create_signer::from_keys.
  2. signEphemeral(String, byte[], String) — signs with an ephemeral self-signed certificate chain; for tests and demos only (the result will not validate against any trust list).

After a successful sign the builder is consumed and must not be used again; the close() call then becomes a no-op. 

try (C2paBuilder builder = new C2paBuilder(wasm, manifestJson)) {
    byte[] signed = builder.signEphemeral("image/jpeg", tileBytes, "fliiifenleger");
}

    • C2paBuilder

      public C2paBuilder(C2paWasm wasm, String manifestJson) throws C2paException
      Create a new builder from a manifest definition JSON string.

      Mirrors Builder::from_context(ctx).with_definition(json) in lib.rs.

      Parameters:
      wasm - Initialised C2paWasm instance.
      manifestJson - Manifest definition in c2pa JSON format.
      Throws:
      C2paException - if the WASM function returns an error.

    • setIntent

      public void setIntent(String intent) throws C2paException
      Set the builder intent.
      Parameters:
      intent - One of "edit", "update", or "create:<source type>" where the source type is a Digital Source Type alias (e.g. "create:digitalCapture") or IPTC URI.
      Throws:
      C2paException - on WASM error.
      IllegalStateException - if this builder has been closed.

    • signWithKeys

      public byte[] signWithKeys(String format, byte[] assetBytes, byte[] certPem, byte[] keyPem, String alg, String tsaUrl) throws C2paException
      Sign an asset in memory using a PEM certificate chain and PEM private key. The signature is computed inside the WASM module.
      Parameters:
      format - MIME type or file extension of the asset.
      assetBytes - Raw asset bytes to embed the manifest in.
      certPem - PEM-encoded certificate chain bytes (must not be null; use signEphemeral(String, byte[], String) to sign without certificates).
      keyPem - PEM-encoded private key bytes (must not be null).
      alg - Signing algorithm string, e.g. "ps256", "es256", "ed25519".
      tsaUrl - Optional timestamp authority URL; null or empty for no timestamping.
      Returns:
      Signed asset bytes.
      Throws:
      C2paException - on WASM error.
      IllegalStateException - if this builder has been closed.

    • signEphemeral

      public byte[] signEphemeral(String format, byte[] assetBytes, String certName) throws C2paException
      Sign an asset in memory using an ephemeral self-signed certificate chain. Intended for tests and demos only — the produced manifest will not validate against any trust list.
      Parameters:
      format - MIME type or file extension of the asset.
      assetBytes - Raw asset bytes to embed the manifest in.
      certName - Common name for the ephemeral end-entity certificate.
      Returns:
      Signed asset bytes.
      Throws:
      C2paException - on WASM error.
      IllegalStateException - if this builder has been closed.
